data_note: This file contains two types of events: (1) VAR-reviewed decisions (type: var_review) — goals disallowed, penalties, card upgrades, mistaken identity; (2) Direct red cards (type: red_card, var_reviewed: false) — shown by referee without VAR. Yellow cards and other non-VAR incidents are excluded.

var_decision.note: The goal by Portugal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Dominik Livakovic to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
Celebrations are cut short for Croatia as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Croatia players look gutted.
